entities.summary: Nwachukwu Iheukwumere Chima Moneke is a Nigerian professional basketball player for Crvena zvezda of the Basketball League of Serbia (KLS), the ABA League and the EuroLeague. At 6" 6 tall, he plays at the power forward position. He also represents the Nigerian national team in international competition.
